notes.title: TheFlagship DevLog#3
notes.content:
Following a recent closed beta test of our core combat systems, we've identified several areas needing refinement. Here's what's changing:
[previewyoutube=0nN3UGkwh48;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Combat System Improvements[/h2]
1. Manual Aiming Overhaul

Replaced automated main cannons with manual aiming + trajectory prediction

Requires precise positioning but rewards skilled shots
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355348/2e73dd8b273392cec4511e59b307816bdd38ae5f.png[/img]

2. Broadside Weapons Update

Added a Rebel Galaxy-inspired charge-based rhythm mechanic

Stage your salvos through timed charges for maximum impact
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355348/43876613988f8c0f6b71f868a660d6a3d428aca7.png[/img]

These weapon system changes establish a modular foundation for future unique armaments.

[h2]Quality-of-Life Upgrades[/h2]

Equipment Management Simplified:

Left-click slots to open equipment interface

Right-click to unequip instantly

Added fighter-class enemies for tactical variety
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355348/6bba6214dc3c2fcc90667d3fc5d1965521eec317.png[/img]

[h2]Store Page Upgrades[/h2]
Comprehensive text optimization highlighting key systems

New dynamic GIFs showcasing:

Capital ship combat dynamics

Modular customization sequences

Replaced placeholder video with new feature trailer

We'll continue refining based on your feedback. Good news - our next test phase will include rogue-like progression elements.

See you in the next update!

notes.title: TheFlagShip Devlog #2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2priOnEWJgg;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Prototype Ships in Early Testing
Four new warship classes are now available for experimental gameplay, These prototypes are functional but not finalized, some key feature about them is still under development

2. Expanded Module System
The revised compartment system now supports deeper strategic customization:

Dual Slot Types: Weapon mounts and equipment bays (e.g., shields, scanners, or experimental tech)

New module properties:

Mass: Heavy armaments reduce maneuverability; counterbalance with thruster upgrades

Energy Draw: High-output weapons require dedicated reactor cores, forcing trade-offs between offense and defense
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355348/d8c8c58e25c08aa0f122df8d03fd48e180985575.png[/img]


3. Lighting & Environment Updates
Addressing player reports about visibility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355348/3adc8741c9f89ad49a215cef3f5742fea10f9798.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355348/d343b5c8375436399edc0a4eef49fef21791ff80.png[/img]
And Yes, This is the new capsule image!
